# GitHub Copilot Instructions

- Read and follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before editing files.
- Read `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md`, `docs/rules/repository-structure.md`,
  `docs/rules/data-contracts.md`, and the relevant component README.
- When a feature has `specs/<feature>/spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `tasks.md`, use
  them as the shared requirements, technical plan, and implementation checklist.
- Check the current task owner. Do not duplicate work or overwrite another
  contributor's changes.
- Check off tasks only after meeting their criteria and completing relevant
  verification. Record evidence in `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md`. Do not automatically
  check off Spec Kit's requirements review checklists.
- After each work session, update the status, open issues, and next steps.
- The complete rules are in `AGENTS.md`. Do not create a separate, conflicting
  rule set.
